cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.
